children: Executed by Posterscope India, the festive outdoor installation uses a moving swing, 3D elements and Havells Wires branding to create a visual Ganpati experience
The festive season has prompted Havells India to take its Ganpati communication beyond a conventional billboard, with a kinetic OOH execution that brings motion to the outdoor format.

Executed by Posterscope India, the installation features Lord Ganesha seated on a traditional swing, with the swing designed to move within the advertising unit. The use of 3D elements adds depth to the visual while the movement creates a more dynamic interaction with audiences passing the hoarding.

The execution combines the festive visual with Havells' brand presence. The Havells logo is positioned alongside the installation, while the lower section carries the message गणपती बाप्पा मोरया. Havells Wires products are also integrated into the creative, connecting the festive setting back to the brand's product portfolio.

The installation uses the physicality of OOH to turn a traditionally static advertising format into a moving visual. Rather than relying solely on a festive graphic, the swing introduces a kinetic element designed to catch attention in a busy outdoor environment.

The execution also comes as Posterscope India continues to explore OOH formats that turn everyday physical spaces into more noticeable brand moments. The agency's recent work has included experiential and location-based OOH executions across different consumer contexts.

For Havells, the Ganpati activation combines a familiar cultural cue with a format-led innovation, using movement and three-dimensionality to give its festive communication greater physical presence on the streets.
The result is a festive OOH execution where the cultural visual remains at the centre, while the moving installation provides an additional layer of engagement.
